name: magi
description: MAGI decision council for Codex research work: frame one decidable proposition, deliberate through orthogonal evidence/cost/evaluation lenses, audit every reason, red-team unanimity, and report a human-arbitrated tally.

interface.longDescription: Turn should-we decisions into a bounded council report without confusing a model tally with the human's ruling.
defaultPrompt: Convene a MAGI council on this decision.
Pressure-test whether we should do this.
